description.en: Small olive bird with a long slender beak, folded feathered wings, two narrow long tail feathers and paired feet. Beak proportions, soft tissue, feather placement and color are simplified for a stylized scene prop; no exact fossil reconstruction is claimed.
description.zh: 橄榄色小鸟，具有细长喙、折叠羽翼、两根细长尾羽和成对足部。喙的比例、软组织、羽毛布局和颜色为场景道具作简化，不作精确化石复原主张。
